# Trail Catalunya

> A live, weekly-updated catalog of 200+ trail-running races in Catalunya (Spain),
> filterable by drive time from Barcelona, distance, elevation gain, and month.
> Built to be used by AI agents: the full race database is exposed as a public
> read-only MCP server, so an assistant can query current data and plan races directly.

## Key facts

- Most races carry a real driving estimate from Plaça Glòries, Barcelona — the field no other calendar publishes (a few newer towns are not yet estimated).
- Race data (distances in km, elevation gain in metres D+, dates) is re-scraped weekly from the Catalan trail-race calendars.
- Volatile facts (start time, registration status, sold-out) should be verified at each race's official URL.

## MCP server (for agents)

- Endpoint: https://qaebfhbdfjvzhmvcjroz.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
- Public, no-auth, read-only. JSON-RPC, MCP protocol version 2025-03-26.
- Tools: search_races (filter by drive time / distance / elevation / month / province / kids-run), get_race (full detail for one race), whats_on (soonest upcoming races).
- Composes with training data: if a Strava or Garmin MCP is also connected, the assistant can join races with recent training locally to estimate race readiness and a rough projected finish time. Training data is never sent to this server.
